questions.q: An orange line on a bridge marks the level reached by an old flood. The town keeps it there to warn future residents. Complete: "The line ___ a reminder of the flood."
o: explained
contributed to
accounted for
served as

exp.trans: 桥上的橙线标出旧洪水曾达到的高度，镇上保留它以提醒后来的居民；这条线起提醒作用。
exp.structure: The line是主语；served as接名词短语a reminder，说明它充当何种提醒标志。
exp.other: resident居民；mark标示；flood洪水。
exp.meaning: serve可以表达发挥作用，但这里需要serve as加角色名词，不能把它笼统替换为所有表示效果的动词。
exp.rest: explained a reminder指解释某个提醒，未表达充当提醒；contributed to a reminder是对提醒有所贡献，不是这条线本身充当提醒；accounted for表示解释或构成，也不自然表达这里的用途角色。

questions.target: 共同动词支配 / 并列任务
questions.q: The inspector recommended replacing the worn belt and checking the tension before restarting the machine. Which reading preserves the recommendation?
o: The inspector reported that both jobs had already been completed.
Replacing the belt was expected to check the tension automatically.
The inspector recommended two tasks: belt replacement and a tension check.
The machine should be restarted before either task is attempted.

exp.trans: 检查员建议在重新启动机器之前更换磨损的皮带并检查张力。建议包含两项任务：更换皮带和检查张力，而不是报告它们已经完成。
exp.structure: The inspector是主语，recommended是谓语。replacing the worn belt与checking the tension是并列动名词短语，共同作recommended的补足内容；before restarting the machine给执行顺序。
exp.other: inspector 检查员；worn belt 磨损的皮带；tension 张力；restart 重新启动。
exp.meaning: and把两项动作放在同一层级，都受recommended支配。后一个动名词不是第一个动作自动产生的效果，也不是新的已完成事实。
exp.rest: had already been completed把建议改成过去已完成事实；check ... automatically把两项独立任务合成一项的自动效果；restarted before either task反转before给出的执行顺序。

questions.q: 你只是中立地询问对方过去是否有过独自搭帐篷的经历，不表达惊讶、责备或否定。哪句准确？
o: Have you even put up a tent by yourself?
Have you over put up a tent by yourself?
Have you never put up a tent by yourself?
Have you ever put up a tent by yourself?

exp.trans: Have you ever put up a tent by yourself?：你曾经独自搭过帐篷吗？
exp.structure: 一般疑问句Have + you + ever + put up + a tent？还原陈述语序为You have put up a tent；have put up是现在完成时谓语，ever是询问以往经历的时间副词。
exp.other: put up a tent 搭帐篷；by yourself 独自；experience 经历；ever 在任何时候、曾经。
exp.meaning: ever用于这里的经历问句，询问截至现在是否发生过。
exp.rest: even：甚至，用在这个问句里会强调‘你连搭帐篷都做过吗’，可能带出惊讶或质疑，不是中立询问。over：可表示在某段时间内或在上方，不能占据这里ever的副词位置。never：从未，否定问句‘难道从没搭过吗’改变了提问语气和预设。

questions.target: the big picture / 整体背景
questions.q: The emergency office assessed drought risk using only last week's rainfall. A researcher urged officials to examine five years of climate data and consider ______ before announcing a new water policy.
o: the next visitor
a single newspaper headline
the big picture
an unrelated complaint

exp.trans: 应急部门仅凭上周降雨量评估干旱风险；研究者建议在宣布新供水政策前查看五年气候数据、考虑整体情况。
exp.structure: The emergency office是主语，assessed是谓语；A researcher urged officials to examine... and consider...，两个不定式动作共同构成建议。
exp.other: drought 干旱；rainfall 降雨量；climate data 气候数据；water policy 供水政策。
exp.meaning: the big picture是整体局面或全貌；与仅凭上周局部数据下判断形成鲜明对比，不是一个单独的大问题。
exp.rest: 下一位访客、某篇报道与无关投诉都不能概括五年的整体数据，无法解释作者要求扩大视野的目的。

questions.target: imagined that ... had not / 提取完整观点
questions.skill: 信念内容不能由后续结果倒推
questions.q: Noor imagined that a software update had not changed her machine's output. Later measurements showed a substantial change. Which statement describes Noor's initial belief?
o: She initially thought the update made no difference.
She had decided to replace the machine entirely.
She knew from the beginning that output had changed greatly.
She was excessively enthusiastic about software updates.

exp.trans: Noor起初认为更新没有改变机器产出，后来的测量才发现变化明显。
exp.structure: Noor imagined that...中that从句作宾语；had not changed是其核心否定谓语；Later measurements引出相反事实。
exp.other: output 产出；substantial 显著的；measurement 测量；initial 初始的。
exp.meaning: 必须区分人物当时相信什么与后来实际发现了什么；不能只因出现update就推定其对软件痴迷。
exp.rest: 更换机器无依据；把后来证据当成最初已知事实颠倒时间；过分热衷更新是附加心理描述。

questions.target: whatever + 名词 / 嵌入式修饰结构
questions.skill: 名词短语内部结构与主句宾语
questions.q: The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain whatever equipment they brought for the project. Which analysis is accurate?
o: The phrase is the subject of lets and refers to the researcher.
The whole phrase is the object of retain; whatever determines equipment.
The phrase is a direct question asking what equipment was brought.
The phrase modifies workshop and explains why the visit occurred.

exp.trans: 工作坊允许每位来访研究人员保留自己为项目带来的任何设备。whatever equipment they brought for the project整体作retain的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句骨架：The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain something。whatever equipment they brought for the project替换something，整体是retain的宾语；whatever限定equipment，they brought for the project修饰equipment。
exp.other: workshop工作坊；visiting researcher来访研究人员；retain保留；equipment设备。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词可表示“任何……/所……的任何东西”。先识别整个名词短语在主句中的位置，再分析短语内部的限定词和修饰从句。
exp.rest: 主句主语是The workshop，不是whatever短语；这里不是直接疑问句；whatever短语不修饰workshop，也不说明访问原因。

questions.target: 总结范围 / 后续核验
questions.q: After presenting a commuter survey, a paragraph says: “To sum up, the new schedule suits many commuters. The council will review it after winter, when school travel patterns change.” What do these lines support?
o: The winter review has already overturned the survey findings.
The council has changed the discussion to the cost of new buses.
The paragraph summarises current findings and identifies a later check.
The survey has measured how school journeys changed during the coming winter.

exp.trans: 在呈现通勤调查后，一段写道：“总的说来，新时刻表适合许多通勤者。委员会将在冬季之后重新评估它，届时学生出行规律会变化。”这些句子总结当前发现，并提出之后的核验。
exp.structure: To sum up引入对已给调查的概括。The new schedule + suits + many commuters。The council + will review + it表达将来的评估；when从句补充冬后出行规律变化。
exp.other: commuter 通勤者；schedule 时刻表；review 重新评估；travel pattern 出行规律。
exp.meaning: 总结当前部分与计划未来检查可以同段共存；未来检查还未发生。单靠总结词或后续计划，不能保证这一段必为全文末段或必有下一段。
exp.rest: already overturned把未来复核改成已完成的推翻；cost of new buses凭空替换主题；has measured ... coming winter把尚未来到的时期说成已取得观测结果。

questions.target: come down with / come up with
questions.skill: come down with / come up with
questions.q: The lead actor came down with flu on opening night, so an understudy performed the role. What happened to the lead actor?
o: He became ill before the performance.
He invented a new role for the show.
He met the understudy unexpectedly.
He published a review of the play.

exp.trans: 主演首演当晚患上流感，因此由替角出演该角色。
exp.structure: 主句The lead actor came down with flu；so连接患病与替角出演这一后续事件。
exp.other: lead actor主演；opening night首演之夜；understudy替角。
exp.meaning: come down with后接疾病，说明患病；需要用事件后果检验短语整体意思。
exp.rest: invented混入come up with想出；met unexpectedly对应come across偶遇；published对应come out的部分用法，均非came down with。

verb-effect-share.q: In a toy prediction model, departure delays explained 40% of the variation in arrival times. Which pair can replace explained while preserving that statistical meaning? Complete with either expression: delays ___ 40% of the variation.
o: served / contributed to
accounted / contributed
explained / accounted for
served as / resulted from

exp.trans: 在一个示例预测模型中，出发延误解释了到达时间差异的40%。此处可使用explained或accounted for。
exp.structure: delays为主语，explained为及物谓语，40% of the variation为宾语；accounted for作为整体连接同一比例。
exp.other: departure出发；variation差异/变异；prediction model预测模型。
exp.meaning: 统计解释份额与用途角色不同；explain与account for在这里可相近改写，不意味着所有语境中都可互换，也不单凭这一句证明因果。
exp.rest: served直接接比例不表达解释份额；contributed to只说明有所贡献，不能代替此处报告的精确解释比例；accounted缺for；served as是充当，resulted from则表达结果来自某原因，方向与比例关系不同。

verb-effect-share.q: A workshop improved output after both staff training and a machine upgrade. The manager says training helped, but has not estimated its share. Which statement preserves the available evidence?
o: Training contributed to the improvement in output.
Training explained 70% of the improvement in output.
Training accounted for the entire improvement in output.
Training served 70% of the improvement in output.

exp.trans: 车间在培训和机器升级后提高了产出。经理只说培训有帮助，没有估算其份额；可说培训对改善有贡献。
exp.structure: Training contributed to the improvement：主语Training，谓语contributed，to后接贡献所指向的结果；不是直接支配比例宾语。
exp.other: output产出；upgrade升级；estimate估算。
exp.meaning: contribute to可以保留有帮助而未量化的关系；explain或account for后带具体份额须有相应证据，不能凭空补出数字。
exp.rest: explained 70%加入未经估算的比例；accounted for the entire把部分贡献扩大成全部；served 70%既补造比例，也没有构成自然的用途或解释份额句型。

verb-effect-share.target: serve a purpose / serve to do
verb-effect-share.skill: serve a purpose / serve to do
verb-effect-share.q: A station ramp is useful because it makes the platforms accessible. Complete both gaps: "It ___ a useful purpose and ___ make access easier."
o: explains; serves as
serves; serves to
accounts for; contributes
contributes to; explains

exp.trans: 车站坡道有实际用途，使人更容易到达站台：它发挥有用作用，并起到便利通行的作用。
exp.structure: 第一空serve直接接a useful purpose；第二空serve to后接动词原形make。两个并列谓语各自要求不同补足结构。
exp.other: ramp坡道；platform站台；accessible可到达、可使用的。
exp.meaning: 知道serve可译为发挥作用，还要掌握serve a purpose、serve as a noun和serve to do三种实际句型。
exp.rest: explains a purpose是解释一个目的，不是发挥用途，serves as后也不能直接接make；contributes须用to连接目标；accounts for a useful purpose和contributes to a useful purpose没有准确表达本句的设施用途。

parallel-governance.q: Which sentence has a clean parallel structure in which the same modal verb governs both alternatives?
o: The technician can either replace the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician either can replace the sensor or recalibration of the device.
The technician can either replacing the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician can either replace the sensor or the device is recalibrated.

exp.trans: 正确句：技术员可以要么更换传感器，要么重新校准设备。
exp.structure: 主干：The technician（主语）+ can（情态动词）+ either replace... or recalibrate...。can同时支配replace和recalibrate，两边都是动词原形，结构完全平行。
exp.other: technician 技术员；sensor 传感器；recalibrate 重新校准；device 设备。
exp.meaning: 共同动词支配时，并列两端应保持同一语法层级。这里 can + replace / recalibrate。
exp.rest: either can replace... or recalibration... 把动词结构和名词结构并列；can either replacing... 中情态动词后不能接-ing形式；replace... or the device is recalibrated 把动词短语和完整从句并列，层级不一致。

parallel-governance.q: The redesign owes its success not to a faster motor but to a simpler control panel. Which reading keeps the shared relation intact?
o: The faster motor owes its success to the control panel.
Success is credited to the panel rather than to the motor.
The simpler panel was made possible by the redesign's earlier success.
The sentence credits the motor and the panel equally.

exp.trans: 这次重新设计的成功不是由于更快的电机，而是由于更简单的控制面板。两个to短语共同说明同一个成功应归因于什么。
exp.structure: The redesign是主语，owes是谓语，its success是宾语。not to a faster motor和but to a simpler control panel是同层并列的归因补足语，都受owes its success支配。
exp.other: redesign 重新设计；owe A to B 把A归因于B；motor 电机；control panel 控制面板。
exp.meaning: 共享的是owe success to...的归因结构，不是让后半句生成新主语或改变成功的所属对象。not...but...排除电机、强调面板。
exp.rest: The faster motor owes...把电机改成主语并换掉success所属对象；panel was made possible...把面板作为成功的结果，反转因果；equally忽略not对电机解释的排除。

even.q: ___ the past decade, the village has become busier than ___ before, and ___ residents who once opposed tourism now run guesthouses.
o: Even / over / ever
Over / ever / even
Ever / even / over
Over / even / ever

diag.0: 第一空需要表示“一段时间内”的 Over；三个词的位置功能被打乱了。
diag.2: Ever 不能在这里表示“过去十年间”；第二空比较结构需要 ever。
diag.3: 第二空 than even before 不成立；第三空应是 even residents=甚至居民。

exp.trans: 在过去十年里，这个村子比以往任何时候都更热闹，甚至一些曾经反对旅游业的居民现在也经营起了民宿。
exp.structure: Over the past decade 是时间范围状语；busier than ever before 是比较结构；even residents... 中 even 强调“甚至这些居民”。
exp.other: decade 十年；oppose 反对；tourism 旅游业；guesthouse 民宿/旅馆。
exp.meaning: over=在……期间；ever=曾经/任何时候；even=甚至。
exp.rest: “Over the past decade”表示一段持续时间；“than ever before”是固定比较表达；“even residents”中的 even 强调连以前反对旅游的居民也加入了经营。把 over、ever、even 换到其他位置，会破坏其中至少一个语法功能或语义关系。

even.q: A new catalogue helped beginners find books. Even among experienced librarians, search times became shorter. What does Even add?
o: It says experienced staff caused the first result.
It cancels the reported benefit for beginners.
It extends the benefit to a less expected group.
It says the second result happened earlier.

exp.trans: 新目录帮助初学者找书；甚至经验丰富的图书馆员也缩短了检索时间。Even把好处推进到较出乎预期的熟练群体。
exp.structure: Even修饰among experienced librarians这一范围短语；search times became shorter是该群体中的陈述，不是前句的原因。
exp.other: catalogue目录；librarian图书馆员；experienced有经验的。
exp.meaning: Even突出递进和意外包含，不取消原命题，也不自动表达因此或时间先后。
exp.rest: caused把递进读成因果；cancels读成否定前文；happened earlier添加时间顺序，均无依据。

even.q: A museum report says: "Not even replacing every bulb solved the lighting problem." Which statement is supported?
o: Only replacing every bulb solved the problem.
No possible change could ever solve the problem.
The museum never replaced any of its old bulbs.
Replacing every bulb did not solve the problem.

exp.trans: 博物馆报告说：甚至把每个灯泡都换掉，也没有解决照明问题。
exp.structure: Not even将否定和强调作用于replacing every bulb这个本应较有希望的措施；solved的成功结果被否定，不是否定尝试曾发生。
exp.other: bulb灯泡；lighting照明；measure措施。
exp.meaning: 此处Even仍突出超出通常预期；not even不等于never tried，也不能把一个措施失败扩大为所有可能措施永远失败。
exp.rest: Only... solved把失败改成唯一成功；No possible change could ever...扩大到一切未来方案；never replaced把措施未奏效误读为根本未实施。

cloze-big-picture.q: A factory manager praised a production line after one unusually productive morning. The annual report, however, showed repeated delays and large repair costs. Which advice is best supported?
o: Celebrate the morning and ignore the report.
Look at the big picture rather than one exceptional shift.
Decide that the line has never produced anything useful.
Assume that annual costs are irrelevant to performance.

exp.trans: 厂长凭一次特别高产的上午就夸奖生产线，但年度报告显示反复延误及高额维修费。评价应着眼整体而非单次样本。
exp.structure: A factory manager + praised + a production line；however引出与单次乐观印象相反的长期证据；Which advice要求概括两边的关系。
exp.other: productive 高产的；annual report 年报；repair cost 维修费用；exceptional 例外的。
exp.meaning: look at the big picture表示看全局、顾及长期背景，避免单凭个别表现判断整体。
exp.rest: 只看那一个上午就是原文批评的做法；断言生产线毫无用处过度概括；完全忽略年度成本也背离证据。

belief-negation-clause.target: assume that ... did not / 被批评的信念
belief-negation-clause.q: A restaurant owner rebuked an apprentice for assuming that the online booking page did not influence walk-in customers. Surveys showed that many visitors discovered the restaurant through the page. What did the apprentice mistakenly believe?
o: The owner had avoided creating an online booking page.
Walk-in customers were unaffected by the booking page.
Customers preferred online orders to meals at the restaurant.
The owner placed excessive importance on online advertising.

exp.trans: 老板批评学徒，因为学徒以为网上订位页面不影响未经预约直接到店的人；调查却显示不少访客就是经此页面了解餐厅。
exp.structure: rebuked an apprentice为主干，for assuming that...说明批评原因，that后的did not influence是学徒持有的错误判断。
exp.other: rebuke 责备；apprentice 学徒；walk-in customer 无预约上门顾客；reservation 预约。
exp.meaning: assume/imagine that表示以为、认为；否定词位于从句中，决定被批评的是低估作用而非对网络的痴迷。
exp.rest: 老板未建网页和顾客点餐偏好均无证据；把老板说成过分重视广告，也没有回答学徒错误地否认网页对临时到店顾客的影响。

nested.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
nested.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
nested.q:
Applicants who believe that a longer résumé automatically proves greater ability often overlook the value of relevance.
哪组句法判断正确？
o: 主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 proves；主句谓语 believe
主句主语 a longer résumé；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 proves

diag.1: proves 属于 that 宾语从句，不是 who 从句的核心谓语；believe 也不是主句谓语。
diag.2: a longer résumé 是 that 从句内部的主语，不是整句主语。
diag.3: proves 是 that 从句谓语；整句主句谓语是 overlook。

exp.trans: 那些认为简历越长就自然能证明能力越强的申请者，往往忽视了“相关性”的价值。
exp.structure: 原始简单句① Applicants often overlook the value of relevance. ② Applicants believe something. ③ A longer résumé automatically proves greater ability. → ②把 something 换成 that 从句：Applicants believe that... → 再把②变成修饰 Applicants 的 who 定语从句：Applicants who believe that... often overlook...。所以整句主语 Applicants，who 从句谓语 believe，that 从句谓语 proves，主句谓语 overlook。
exp.other: applicant 申请者；résumé 简历；automatically 自然而然地/自动地；relevance 相关性。
exp.meaning: 看到 who 后先划到从句结束，再找主句谓语；who 从句里又可嵌套 that 宾语从句。
exp.rest: 把 that 从句的谓语 proves 误当成外层谓语，或把其中的 a longer résumé 误当成整句主语，都会错过：Applicants 是主句主语，believe 是 who 从句谓语，overlook 是主句谓语。

nested.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
nested.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
nested.q:
Residents who discovered that the shared gate was unlocked called the caretaker.
按“主句主语中心词 / who从句谓语 / 主句谓语”的顺序，哪组正确？
o: Residents / discovered / called
the shared gate / discovered / was
Residents / was unlocked / discovered
the caretaker / called / discovered

exp.trans: 发现公共大门没有锁上的住户给管理员打了电话。
exp.structure: 简单句①Residents called the caretaker. ②Residents discovered something. ③The shared gate was unlocked. → 把③接在discovered后：Residents discovered that the shared gate was unlocked. → 把重复的Residents换成who并嵌入①：Residents [who discovered [that the shared gate was unlocked]] called the caretaker。主句完整主语包含who从句，中心词是Residents。
exp.other: resident 住户；shared 共用的；unlocked 没锁上的；caretaker 管理员。
exp.meaning: 发现这件事的是住户；没有锁上的是大门；打电话给管理员的还是住户。三个小句的主语和谓语不能串层。
exp.rest: the shared gate只在that从句中作主语，不能升为主句主语。was unlocked属于that从句，discovered属于who从句；两者都不是主句谓语。the caretaker是called的宾语，不是发现大门未锁的人。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Engineers who noticed that the valve was leaking shut down the line. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Engineers / noticed / shut down
the valve / noticed / was leaking
Engineers / was leaking / noticed
the line / shut down / noticed

exp.trans: 注意到阀门漏液的工程师关闭了生产线。按题目要求的顺序，主句主语中心词是Engineers，who从句谓语是noticed，主句谓语是shut down。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Engineers shut down the line；who noticed...修饰Engineers；that the valve was leaking是noticed的宾语从句。三个谓语分别属于不同层级。
exp.other: engineer 工程师；valve 阀门；leak 漏液；shut down 关闭、停运；subject head 主语中心词。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。阀门是that从句的主语，工程师才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the valve只在that从句中作主语；was leaking属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the line是shut down的宾语，不是主句主语。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Editors who learned that the quote was inaccurate removed it from the draft. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Editors / learned / removed
the quote / learned / was
Editors / was / learned
the draft / removed / learned

exp.trans: 得知引文不准确的编辑把它从草稿中删掉了。主句主语中心词是Editors，who从句谓语是learned，主句谓语是removed。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Editors removed it from the draft；who learned...修饰Editors；that the quote was inaccurate是learned的宾语从句。三个谓语属于不同层级。
exp.other: editor 编辑；quote 引文；inaccurate 不准确的；draft 草稿。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。quote是that从句的主语，Editors才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the quote只在that从句中作主语；was属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the draft是介词from的宾语，不是主句主语。

nested.target: whatever + 名词 / 整体作宾语
nested.skill: 名词性结构与从句内部关系
nested.q: The registrar will accept whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday. What role does the underlined phrase play?
o: It is the object of accept: any documents the applicant submits.
It is the subject of submits and refers to the registrar.
It asks which documents the applicant may submit.
It modifies Friday and explains the reason for the deadline.

exp.trans: 登记员会接受申请人在周五之前提交的任何文件。whatever documents the applicant submits整体作accept的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句：The registrar will accept something。whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday整体替代something，作accept的宾语；the applicant submits是修饰documents的限定性关系结构，documents是submits的宾语。
exp.other: registrar登记员；applicant申请人；submit提交；deadline截止时间。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词表示任何符合后续限定的该类事物；整个短语可以在主句中作宾语。要区分外层动词accept与内层从句谓语submits。
exp.rest: underlined phrase不是submits的主语，内层主语是the applicant；这不是直接疑问句；Friday是before的宾语，不是被whatever短语修饰的对象，也没有说明截止原因。

prompt_marks.text: whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday

summary-location.q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It announces the final conclusion of the entire article.
It sums up the first phase before further cost analysis.
It introduces an example unrelated to the first phase.
It signals doubt about the first phase's reported results.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 后文还要分析成本，不能判为全文终结；这句话概括第一阶段而非引入无关例子；Overall本身不表示对结果存疑。

summary-location.target: 局部总结 / 段尾钩子
summary-location.q: A paragraph says: “Taken together, the short trials show that the sensor detects small leaks. That finding raises a further question: can it operate for weeks without a battery change?” Which next paragraph would best develop the hook?
o: A report of a month-long run and its power use.
A repetition of the first trial’s one-hour detection rate.
A history of the material used in the first sensor.
A claim that accurate detection already proves long battery life.

exp.trans: 一段写道：“短期试验合起来表明传感器能检测到小泄漏。这个发现引出进一步的问题：不换电池，它能否运行数周？”最能展开段尾钩子的是长达一个月的运行和耗电报告。
exp.structure: Taken together概括short trials；the sensor + detects + small leaks是that宾语从句。That finding回指检测结果。can it operate...?的问题将检测能力推进到长期供电能力。
exp.other: trial 试验；leak 泄漏；operate 运转；power use 耗电量。
exp.meaning: 局部总结不是全文封口。选下一段要回应新的运行时长问题，而非机械重复已总结的检测准确性。
exp.rest: one-hour detection rate只重复旧测试，未回答数周运行；material history转去材料背景，未接耗电问题；accurate detection proves long battery life把检测能力当成续航证据，两项指标不能自动互证。

phrasal-verb-illness.target: come across / come up with / come down with
phrasal-verb-illness.skill: come across / come up with / come down with
phrasal-verb-illness.q: A diary says: "I came across an old friend in the port, came up with a new route, and came down with a fever on the way home." Which sequence does it report?
o: Arranged a meeting; lost a route; recovered.
Met by chance; devised a route; became ill.
Published a story; followed a route; returned.
Missed a friend; rejected a route; got better.

exp.trans: 日记说作者在港口偶遇老朋友，想出新路线，回程中发烧患病。
exp.structure: 三个并列谓语came across、came up with、came down with分别支配friend、route、fever；不能单看come或with。
exp.other: port港口；route路线；devise想出、设计。
exp.meaning: 动词短语需要整体与其宾语、事件类型对应，而非只根据一粒介词猜测。
exp.rest: arranged把偶遇说成安排；lost、rejected不是想出路线；recovered、got better与患病方向相反；published也不符合这三个短语。
